data.title: About reports and payouts.
items: Do I need a Razorpay account?
To sell tickets, yes. It works for individuals with a PAN and a bank account, and we’ll help you set it up. Free events don’t need one.
When do I get my money?
Guests pay into your Razorpay account, and Razorpay sends it to your bank on its usual schedule for your account. Catch doesn’t hold it.
One bill after each billing period: 5% of ticket sales, memberships and form fees, net of refunds, never more than ₹10,000. Nothing during your trial.
Can more than one person run my events?
Yes. Add co-hosts to your team, and give helpers door access for a single event that ends when it does.
Yes. Export your guest records, and your report shows bookings and revenue by link.
Your Razorpay account and invoices are yours, so GST on your tickets follows your own registration. Catch’s bill to you is separate.
